generic:label: class labels in train and val are wrong
disagree with movie_time_s from the stimulus log

data_issues: stim_class labels in train and val are wrong: they disagree with movie_time_s from the stimulus log for every trial, offset by a cyclic shift of 2 (stim_class = (movie_time_s - 16) mod 10, e.g. movie_time 14 s is labelled 8, 16 s is labelled 0). Neural temporal continuity (the end of each segment best matches the start of the next segment in movie-time order) supports movie_time_s being correct, so I relabelled as class = movie_time_s - 14 per classes.json before training.
